common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.disclaimer: ClaimSathi is a self-help drafting tool, not legal advice. You send everything yourself.
common.freeChannels: Your insurer's grievance officer, Bima Bharosa and the Insurance Ombudsman are free. Never pay anyone claiming to be the Ombudsman.

home.title: Health claim cut or rejected?
home.subtitle: Find out why, and write to your insurer with the rules on your side.
home.point3: See which deductions have no clause cited, and get a letter
home.free: Free · No success fee · You send everything
home.scope: This early version reads text PDFs (not photos) and writes letters in English.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com
signIn.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
signIn.spam: Not there? Check your spam folder.
signIn.wrongCode: That code isn't right. {left} tries left.
signIn.expired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
signIn.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
signIn.failed: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.
signIn.consentNote: We'll ask your permission before reading any documents.

consent.title: Before we read your documents
consent.draft: DRAFT notice, pending legal review. This version is for testing only.
consent.whatBody: The documents you upload, the details we read from them, and your email address.
consent.whyBody: To explain your claim decision, check deductions, write your letter and remind you of deadlines.
consent.aiBody: An AI service reads your documents to find details. The provider will be named here before launch, and processing will stay in India.
consent.keepBody: Uploaded files are deleted 90 days after you close a case. You can delete everything at any time.
consent.processing: I agree that ClaimSathi may process my documents for this purpose
consent.processingRequired: Required. We need this to read your documents.

cases.title: My cases
cases.empty: No cases yet. Start with your insurer's letter.
cases.limit: You have reached the open-case limit. Close a case to start another.

newCase.title: New case
newCase.q1: Is this a health insurance claim with an insurer in India?
newCase.q3: What kind of policy is it?
newCase.q5: Is this matter already in any court, consumer commission or arbitration?
newCase.outOfScope: ClaimSathi only helps with health insurance claims in India.
newCase.litigationNote: We can still help you write to the insurer, but the Ombudsman can't take a matter that's already in court.

documents.title: Upload your documents
documents.intro: Start with the letter from your insurer (rejection or settlement letter).
documents.limits: Up to 15 files, 50 MB in total, 20 MB each. PDF only in this version.
documents.waiting: Waiting for documents to finish reading. You can leave this page.

errors.payload_too_large: This file is too large. The limit is 20 MB.
errors.unsupported_media_type: Only PDF files are supported in this version.
errors.case_upload_limit: This case has reached its upload limit.
errors.storage_full: Uploads are paused for a while. Please try again later.
errors.no_text_layer: This PDF has no readable text (it may be a scan). Photo and scan support is coming.

details.title: Check what we read
details.intro: Fix anything that's wrong. We only use details you confirm.
details.matches: Deductions add up to the deducted amount.
details.mismatch: Line items don't add up to the deducted amount. Please check.

findings.title: Findings
findings.noClauseSummary: {count} deductions ({amount}) have no specific policy clause cited.
findings.synthetic: SYNTHETIC test source, not real legal text
findings.limited: We couldn't find your policy wording, so we checked the rules only.
findings.stale: Your details changed. Update the findings.
findings.dropped: Some suggestions were removed because we couldn't verify their sources.
findings.cannotAssessHelp: The clause exists in your policy wording. A detailed check of whether it applies is coming in a later version.

letter.title: Your letter to the insurer
letter.basic: Basic letter: written from your confirmed details and verified rules.
letter.read: I've read this letter and it's correct
letter.readFirst: Please tick the box after reading the letter.
letter.sendNote: You send this letter yourself, by email or post, to your insurer's grievance officer.
